business_oracles.proof: Successful independent provider jobs call the committed ORM runner, which rejects any missing/mismatched result. Phase markers alone do not prove success; the enclosing job/step conclusion is also required.
business_oracles.selected_columns: Fixture has an unselected 8192-byte field with 1024-byte field limit; the narrow DTO projection succeeds.
business_oracles.query: Optional filters, nullable left join, grouped aggregate, Fluent/parameterized SQL DTO equality, complete composite cursor ties/end and empty relations.
business_oracles.protocol_counter: SQLite must be 0; PostgreSQL at least 2. Exact historical first-run PostgreSQL value 10 is retained only in the historical record. These are libpq protocol submissions, not physical network round trips.
business_oracles.writes: Find by composite key, unset-versus-null partial update, stale version rejection, insert-returning, confirmed callback result, callback fault rollback and pre-cancel.
business_oracles.schema: Reviewable creation migration is applied; an unapproved destructive change rejects and reviewed drop SQL is inspected without executing it. Live-generated customer and composite order entities compile and query in later phases.
business_oracles.native_reuse: The exact restored top-level provider native payload equals every loaded/publish native hash across all 3 phases. Original→edited changes only Models.cs source; DtoEdit also selects prewritten managed projection/SQL branches. Scaffold source hashes stay fixed and executable hash changes.
business_oracles.isolation: One Korda PackageReference, no ProjectReference, source-tree-external temporary projects, private application caches, exact selected package version, direct Native AOT ELF and no adjacent application DLL.

inspection_boundary.required: Successful exact registry read-back verification, non-skipped --public Native AOT consumer step, visible B24_RESULT and all six ORM phase start markers plus successful completion.
inspection_boundary.unavailable: The release workflow does not upload detailed public business JSON/raw phase logs or signature-verifier temporary files. Do not claim independent inspection of those files.
inspection_boundary.native_identity: Signed NuGet ZIP hashes may differ because the repository signature is added; identical unsigned payload/native bytes and exact ID/version are enforced.
inspection_boundary.initial_artifact_scope: Only the first historical candidate archives were independently unpacked before executor loss. Current artifacts are identified by GitHub metadata and checked by CI; their detailed archive contents were not independently unpacked afterward.

executor_boundary: After the workspace became unavailable, no later local execution is claimed. Remote Git Data changes used expected-head leases and exact readback; normal CI supplied final execution.

plan_ci.scope: Current DB-API progress gate with seven negative controls and every unchanged historical completion/provenance gate. The evidence-only closeout's own CI is checked separately.

retained_smoke_label: The retained package smoke output still labels itself DB-CPP-01. New DB-API-01 business acceptance is the separate three-phase ORM runner, not that legacy task label.
